footer.tagline: Calm, considered Pilates for busy professionals

hero.eyebrow: Boutique Pilates, Five Minutes From the Financial District
hero.subtitle: Northside Pilates is a quiet, considered studio for professionals who want to move well in the time they have. Reformer and mat classes run from 6am to 8pm, with private sessions available around your calendar.

classTypes.title: Six ways to move, one calm room
classTypes.subtitle: Every class is capped to keep attention on your form, not the headcount. Choose what fits your week, swap whenever you need to.

items.title: Reformer Flow
items.description: A flowing, full-body sequence on the reformer that builds core control, posture and length without strain.

items.title: Mat Foundations
items.description: Classic mat Pilates focused on breath, alignment and the deep stabilizing muscles that support everything else.

items.title: Private 1:1 Sessions
items.description: One-on-one time with an instructor to work on specific goals, old injuries or simply a packed, unpredictable week.

items.title: Express Lunch Reset
items.description: A focused, efficient reformer session designed to fit a lunch break, in and changed within the hour.

items.title: Prenatal Pilates
items.description: Gentle, trimester-adapted movement that builds strength and stability for pregnancy and recovery.

items.title: Small Group Strength
items.description: A small-group reformer class with light resistance work, capped at six to keep coaching personal.

instructors.title: Taught by people who actually watch you move
instructors.subtitle: Every instructor at Northside is certified in classical and contemporary Pilates, with ongoing training in rehabilitation and prenatal work.

items.name: Maya Chen
items.bio: Maya opened Northside after a decade teaching in corporate wellness programs, convinced professionals needed a calmer, more consistent studio.

items.name: Daniel Osei
items.bio: Daniel trained in classical Pilates in London and focuses on precision, bringing a quiet intensity to every reformer session he leads.

items.name: Priya Nair
items.bio: A former physiotherapist, Priya designs the studio's prenatal and post-injury programming and works closely with clients' care teams.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no long-term contracts
pricing.subtitle: Pick the pace that fits your week. Every plan includes access to reformer, mat and small group classes.

items.name: Drop-In
items.description: For a first visit or an occasional reset between travel and deadlines.

items.name: Monthly Unlimited
items.description: Our most popular plan, for clients who come two or more times a week.

items.name: Founding Member
items.description: A limited annual-commitment rate for clients ready to make Pilates part of their routine.

studioInfo.title: A quiet room built for focus
studioInfo.subtitle: Northside sits just off the main transit line, five minutes from the financial district, so a class fits before work, at lunch, or on the way home.

details.label: Studio hours
details.value: Mon to Fri, 6am to 8pm. Sat, 8am to 1pm

details.label: Booking window
details.value: Classes open two weeks in advance

freeTrial.title: Your first class is on us
freeTrial.subtitle: Leave your email and we'll send you a link to book any class on the schedule, reformer or mat, no commitment required.
freeTrial.successMessage: You're in. Check your inbox for a booking link.
